summary: The audit checks the 135 graduate units, all in courses numbered 200 or above, and DLCL 301 and DLCL 369, taken for a letter grade where one is offered. Faculty expect a B+ or better and review lower grades, which the audit does not treat as failing. Checked by hand, because fields are not in course codes: four graduate courses in your major field and two in each of two minor areas (one from a different group), two letter-graded department graduate courses each quarter before TGR, the qualifying and comprehensive exams, candidacy, the University Oral, the dissertation and the language requirement.
